name: md-lang-id-preserved
body:
The structural scanner emits the `md` language id for Markdown, so every non-root Markdown FQN is `md.`-rooted: the heading Structs (`md.AGENTS.md.<heading-path>`, `md.README.md.<heading-path>`, `md.opencode-suite/agents/*.md.<heading-path>`) and the non-root dir modules (`md.opencode-suite/agents`, `md.plans`). This packaging consolidation absorbs the Markdown frontend's code into the bundled scanner and keeps graph identity; a new id (e.g. a `text` root) moves every Markdown FQN for zero benefit.

The repo-root module renders repo-relative as `md.`, the repo-relative reading of SPEC.md §4.3's `<repo-relative-dir>` rule (the same reading as the brief's `toml.` example). A checkout-basename root module contradicts `requirements.requirement.portable-graph-identity`, `requirements.requirement.frontend-rooting-from-repo-base`, the checkout-named-module law, and `domain.value.module-identity`. Heading Structs of root files keep their file-rooted form (`md.AGENTS.md.*`), which stands free of the module identity.

Acceptance: a scan of this repo produces the non-root `md.*` module FQN set (`md.opencode-suite/agents`, `md.plans`) and the heading Struct FQN set (`md.AGENTS.md.*`, `md.README.md.*`, `md.opencode-suite/agents/*.md.*`), and the repo-root module renders as `md.` rather than the checkout basename `md.apg`; the Markdown heading Structs resolve.
